questions.question: When loading or unloading explosive materials, what should you do?

options.text: Use sharp-pointed tools to open packages.

questions.explanation: Always turn off your engine before loading or unloading explosives. Never drop, throw, or roll packages with explosives.

questions.question: What happens if a trailer's wheels lock up?

options.text: The trailer will usually move straight.

questions.explanation: When a trailer's wheels lock up, it tends to swing around. This can cause a jackknife.

questions.question: If brakes pull to one side when you use them, what does this mean?

options.text: The brakes need to be checked.

questions.correctAnswerText: The brakes need to be checked.
questions.explanation: If your vehicle pulls to one side when braking, there is a brake problem. Have the brakes fixed before driving. It is illegal to operate an unsafe vehicle.

questions.question: A person working on a disabled vehicle on the road shoulder:

options.text: Will be paying attention to traffic.
May not see traffic because they are focused on repairs.
Does not have to follow traffic laws.

questions.correctAnswerText: May not see traffic because they are focused on repairs.
questions.explanation: Be careful when driving near people fixing disabled vehicles. They may be focused on their work and not paying attention to traffic.

questions.question: After coupling, how much space should there be between the upper and lower fifth wheel?
questions.explanation: Before you start driving, check all couplings. There should be no space between the upper and lower fifth wheel.

questions.question: Who must place placards on a vehicle?
questions.explanation: The shipper provides placards, but the driver is responsible for placing them on the vehicle.

questions.question: What can change a vehicle's height?
questions.explanation: A heavy load makes a vehicle sit lower. An empty vehicle sits higher than one with a full load. If your truck fits under a bridge when loaded, it may not fit when empty.

questions.question: If you need to stop quickly while carrying liquids, a safe option is to:
questions.explanation: Use the stab braking method for a quick stop with liquid cargo. Do not steer quickly while braking, as this can tip your vehicle over, especially if it has a high center of gravity.

questions.question: If a heavy load is slowing you down, which lane should you use?
questions.explanation: The right lanes are for slower traffic. If a heavy load is slowing you down, stay in the right lane.

questions.question: How many hours of sleep does an adult need each night to stay alert?
questions.explanation: To drive safely, you need proper rest. Most adults need eight to nine hours of sleep each night to stay alert.

questions.question: Which sign shows that a driver is drowsy?

options.text: Your eyes go out of focus on their own
You have trouble holding your head up
You drift from lane to lane

questions.explanation: Signs of drowsy driving include your eyes closing or going out of focus on their own, trouble keeping your head up, and drifting between lanes.

questions.question: The best way to know your trailer is skidding is by:
questions.explanation: The best way to catch a trailer skid early is to see the trailer move sideways in your mirrors.

questions.question: When you approach a railroad crossing, you should:

options.text: Speed up to cross the tracks quickly
Roll down your window to listen for a train
Never try to beat an approaching train

questions.correctAnswerText: Never try to beat an approaching train
questions.explanation: Slow down as you approach a railroad crossing. You may not hear a train, and signals may not warn you. Never try to beat a train across the tracks.

questions.question: When you enter a foggy area, you should:

options.text: Stop on the side of the road

questions.explanation: Slow down before entering fog. Use low beam headlights. Do not pass other vehicles or stop on the roadway. The safest choice is to avoid driving in fog if you can.

questions.question: A 20-inch steering wheel can safely have how much play?
questions.explanation: A steering wheel with more than 10 degrees of play may be broken. On a 20-inch wheel, this equals about two inches of movement at the wheel's edge.

questions.question: What do bulkheads do?

options.text: Divide one large tank into several smaller tanks
Control the temperature of liquid in a tank
Show how full a tank is
Add extra storage space in a tank

questions.correctAnswerText: Divide one large tank into several smaller tanks
questions.explanation: Bulkheads split a large tank into multiple smaller tanks. When driving a tank truck with bulkheads, pay special attention to how the weight is distributed.

questions.question: Most drivers are least alert:
questions.explanation: Tiredness and lack of focus are major dangers when driving at night. Most people are least alert at night, especially after midnight.

questions.question: About hydroplaning:

options.text: It only happens at very high speeds
It can happen at speeds as low as 30 mph
It happens most when tire pressure is too high
It happens most when tires have good tread

questions.correctAnswerText: It can happen at speeds as low as 30 mph
questions.explanation: Hydroplaning can happen at speeds as low as 30 mph if there is enough water on the road. It is most likely when tire pressure is too low or when tires are worn.

questions.question: What affects stopping distance?
questions.explanation: Speed affects how far it takes to stop your vehicle. The faster you drive, the longer you need to stop.

questions.question: Federal and state laws require:

options.text: Drivers to inspect their vehicles regularly
Drivers to inspect vehicles only if they suspect a problem
Drivers to inspect vehicles only when traveling out-of-state
Drivers to inspect vehicles only when carrying hazardous materials

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers to inspect their vehicles regularly
questions.explanation: Federal and state laws require drivers to inspect their vehicles before every trip. Regular inspections help catch problems before they become dangerous and costly.
